topic: Retag low findings left open: whole source in memory, and a failed copy lookup skipping the replace check
detail: Security audit of SP-071, low: (L3) rag.Service.Retag reads every chunk of the source with its vectors into memory while holding the migration lock; the RPC is operator-only and a 2,000-chunk source moves in under 3 s, but a very large source is unbounded. (L5, pre-existing) in the Ingest RPC, when reading the stored copy fails, the mayReplace check is skipped and the write goes on, so its removeElsewhere can delete a retagged copy in another space; failing closed when the copy cannot be read would close it. Options: page the move in batches; return Unavailable from Ingest when Copy errors.
